zh: 我们上次见面时你提到了你小时候的事。
old_en: Last time we met, you brought up your childhood.
new_en: You brought up your childhood when we last met.

zh: 我记得上次聚会时你提到了你小时候的趣事。
old_en: I remember you brought up some funny stories from your childhood at the last party.
new_en: I remember you brought up funny stories from your childhood at the last party.

zh: 我上次和你提起过我想让孩子学乐器。
old_en: Last time I brought up my plan to let my kid learn an instrument.
new_en: Last time I talked to you, I brought up my idea of having my child learn an instrument.

zh: 上次你提到过孩子需要更多的户外活动。
old_en: Last time you brought up that kids need more time outdoors.
new_en: Last time, you mentioned that kids need more outdoor activities.
